summary: The PR replaces Django's custom HTML escaping implementation with the standard library's `html.escape()` function, which improves performance. However, it introduces a potential backward-incompatible change by converting single quotes to `'` instead of `'`. Additionally, the new test cases cover most common scenarios but could benefit from additional edge cases.

issues.description: The change introduces a backward-incompatible behavior by converting single quotes to `'`, which may affect existing applications.
While the test cases cover many scenarios, they could be expanded to include more edge cases to ensure comprehensive coverage.
